where.if: AND (u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR u.short_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR u.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR f.body LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR f.id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_feedback f JOIN app_user u ON u.id=f.owner_id

SELECT f.id,f.owner_id,u.nickname,u.short_id,u.mobile,f.category,f.body,f.state,f.content_id,f.request_id,f.created_at,f.updated_at,v.title content_title FROM user_feedback f JOIN app_user u ON u.id=f.owner_id LEFT JOIN learning_content c ON c.id=f.content_id LEFT JOIN content_version v ON v.id=c.published_version_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN f.state='open' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,f.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}

SELECT f.id,f.owner_id,u.nickname,u.short_id,u.mobile,f.category,f.body,f.state,f.content_id,f.request_id,f.created_at,f.updated_at,v.title content_title FROM user_feedback f JOIN app_user u ON u.id=f.owner_id LEFT JOIN learning_content c ON c.id=f.content_id LEFT JOIN content_version v ON v.id=c.published_version_id WHERE f.id=#{id}
